firstPlayerRule: The player with the sunniest smile may choose who starts.
clarifications: The smile criterion chooses who may nominate the starter; that person is not automatically the first player.
Players take turns; the English rules do not specify a clockwise or counterclockwise direction.
When all weather tiles have been revealed, turn them face down, mix them and continue playing. This does not select a new starter.
The game is cooperative: the players win or lose together, rather than comparing individual final scores.
The rules list 1–5 players. With one player, there is no first-player choice to make; no separate solo opening procedure is given.
